chunks.ar: كان في خدمة مسجد رجل لا يعرف القراءة ولا الكتابة،
chunks.en_old: A mosque servant who could neither read nor write
chunks.en_new: A man who served at a mosque could neither read nor write,
chunks.note: Arabic re-chunked at phrase boundaries (owner request); English follows

chunks.ar: لكنه يجيد خداع الناس. قرر يومًا أن يفتح مدرسة للصغار،
chunks.en_old: decided to open a school.
chunks.en_new: but he was skilled at deceiving people. One day he decided to open a school for children,
chunks.note: Arabic re-chunked at phrase boundaries (owner request); English follows

chunks.ar: فجمع ألواحًا وأوراقًا وعلقها على الجدران، ثم لبس عمامة كبيرة.
chunks.en_old: He hung up tablets and papers and put on a large turban.
chunks.en_new: so he gathered tablets and papers, hung them on the walls, and put on a large turban.
chunks.note: Arabic re-chunked at phrase boundaries (owner request); English follows

chunks.ar: ظن المارة أن صاحب العمامة عالم كبير،
chunks.en_old: Passersby mistook his appearance for scholarship
chunks.en_new: Passersby thought the man in the turban was a great scholar,

chunks.ar: فأرسلوا أبناءهم إليه.
chunks.en_old: and enrolled their children.
chunks.en_new: and enrolled their children.

chunks.ar: كان يشير إلى طفل ويقول اكتب، وإلى آخر ويقول اقرأ،
chunks.en_old: He told one child to write and another to read,
chunks.en_new: He would point to one child and say write, and to another and say read,

chunks.ar: بينما يتعلم الأطفال من بعضهم، ولا يشرح المعلم شيئًا بنفسه.
chunks.en_old: while the pupils taught one another.
chunks.en_new: while the children learned from one another, and the teacher explained nothing himself.

chunks.ar: ذات يوم جاءت امرأة تحمل رسالة من زوجها المسافر.
chunks.en_old: One day a woman arrived with a letter from her traveling husband.
chunks.en_new: One day a woman arrived with a letter from her traveling husband.

chunks.ar: أراد الرجل الهرب قبل أن تطلب قراءتها، لكنه لم يستطع.
chunks.en_old: Unable to escape,
chunks.en_new: The man wanted to flee before she asked him to read it, but he could not.

chunks.ar: ناولته الورقة وسألته عما كتب زوجها،
chunks.en_old: the impostor held the page upside down
chunks.en_new: She handed him the paper and asked what her husband had written,

chunks.ar: فأمسكها مقلوبة أمام عينيه.
chunks.en_old: and pretended to read.
chunks.en_new: and he held it upside down before his eyes.

chunks.ar: أخذ يهز رأسه ويظهر القلق،
chunks.en_old: He shook his head and looked distressed.
chunks.en_new: He shook his head and looked distressed.

chunks.ar: فخافت المرأة وظنت أن زوجها مات.
chunks.en_old: The woman assumed her husband had died;
chunks.en_new: and the woman grew afraid, thinking her husband had died.

chunks.ar: سألته هل تمزق ثيابها وتلطم وجهها حزنًا،
chunks.en_old: when she asked whether to tear her clothes and beat her face,
chunks.en_new: She asked whether she should tear her clothes and slap her face in grief,

chunks.ar: فأجابها بالموافقة، من غير أن يعرف كلمة واحدة في الرسالة.
chunks.en_old: he agreed.
chunks.en_new: and he said yes, without knowing a single word of the letter.

chunks.ar: رجعت المرأة إلى بيتها تبكي مع أطفالها.
chunks.en_old: She returned home weeping with her children.
chunks.en_new: She returned home weeping with her children.

chunks.ar: سمع جارها الخبر، فقال إنه تلقى بالأمس رسالة من زوجها تؤكد أنه بخير وسيعود قريبًا.
chunks.en_old: A neighbor who had recently heard from her husband
chunks.en_new: Her neighbor heard the news and said he had received a letter from her husband yesterday, saying he was well and would return soon.

chunks.ar: طلب الورقة وقرأ ما فيها أمامها.
chunks.en_old: asked to see the letter and read it aloud.
chunks.en_new: He asked for the paper and read it in front of her.

chunks.ar: كانت الرسالة تقول إن الزوج سليم وسيعود بعد عشرة أيام،
chunks.en_old: The husband was well and would return in ten days;
chunks.en_new: The husband was well and would return in ten days;

chunks.ar: وإنه أرسل لحافًا وأداة لإطفاء الشموع.
chunks.en_old: he had sent a quilt and a candle extinguisher.
chunks.en_new: he had sent a quilt and a candle extinguisher.

chunks.ar: غضبت المرأة، وحملت الرسالة مرة أخرى إلى المدرسة لتسأل المعلم لماذا أخافها هكذا.
chunks.en_old: Furious, the woman went back to confront the teacher.
chunks.en_new: The woman grew angry and took the letter back to the school to ask the teacher why he had frightened her so.

chunks.ar: لم يعترف الرجل بأنه أمي، بل اخترع جوابًا عجيبًا.
chunks.en_old: Rather than admit he was illiterate, the man invented a strange explanation:
chunks.en_new: The man did not admit he was illiterate, but invented a strange answer.

chunks.ar: قال إنه ظن الزوج ميتًا ملفوفًا في اللحاف،
chunks.en_old: he claimed to have imagined the husband dead inside the quilt,
chunks.en_new: He said he had thought the husband was dead, wrapped in the quilt,

chunks.ar: لأن أداة إطفاء الشموع كانت معه، وادعى أن هذا سبب حزنه عند قراءة الرسالة.
chunks.en_old: with the extinguisher beside him.
chunks.en_new: because the candle extinguisher was with him, and he claimed this was why he grieved when reading the letter.

chunks.ar: والأغرب أن المرأة قبلت هذا التفسير وانصرفت دون أن تكشف حيلته.
chunks.en_old: Strangely, she accepted his excuse and left.
chunks.en_new: Stranger still, the woman accepted this explanation and left without exposing his trick.
chunks.note: Arabic re-chunked at phrase boundaries (owner request); English follows

chunks.ar: وبقي الرجل جالسًا في مدرسته بعمامته الكبيرة،
chunks.en_old: The impostor remained at his school in his enormous turban,
chunks.en_new: And the man stayed sitting in his school in his large turban,
chunks.note: Arabic re-chunked at phrase boundaries (owner request); English follows

chunks.ar: يترك الأطفال يتعلمون وحدهم، وقد نجا من سؤال كان يمكن أن يفضحه.
chunks.en_old: having escaped exposure once again.
chunks.en_new: leaving the children to learn alone, having escaped a question that could have exposed him.
chunks.note: Arabic re-chunked at phrase boundaries (owner request); English follows
